quotations.old_english: Eálá gé ðeówan . . . swá hwæt swá gé wyrcað, wyrcað mid móde, swá swá Gode sylfum
quotations.latin: servi . . . quodcumque facitis ex animo (heartily, A.V.) operamini, sicut Domino (Col. 2, 23)

quotations.old_english: Ic eów sumes fyrstes geann þ-bar; gé eów sylfe beþencean and on beteran móde gebringan

source_text: ad bibendum, Hml. A. 93, 25. Eálá gé ðeówan . . . swá hwæt swá gé wyrcað, wyrcað mid móde, swá swá Gode sylfum servi . . . quodcumque facitis ex animo (heartily, A.V.) operamini, sicut Domino (Col. 2, 23), Hml. Th. ii. 336, 23. Ic eów sumes fyrstes geann þ-bar; gé eów sylfe beþencean and on beteran móde gebringan, Hml. S. 23, 188. v. ge-, meaht-, þole-, un-mód.
